blocks.title: TM Vibrant Shaders
blocks.tagline: Real-time lighting, weather and skies for TrackMania Nations Forever, United Forever and TrackMania 2.

items.title: Light and shadow
items.text: Ambient occlusion, sun and long-range shadows, light shafts, bounce light and glowing neon borders.

items.title: Weather
items.text: Rain with sound and lightning, wet roads with reflections, snow, storms and water with waves.

items.title: Skies
items.text: Volumetric clouds, starry nights, aurora, a black hole that lights the track and the Ring World.

items.title: Camera and photo mode
items.text: HDR bloom, auto exposure, LUT looks, anti-aliasing and a photo mode without the HUD.

items.title: Video export
items.text: Shoot video in the replay editor: encoded on the graphics card, HDR10, with the game's own sound.

items.title: Presets to share
items.text: A menu with a card and live preview for every preset. Share any look as one line of text.

items.title: Author's Shader
items.text: A map can carry its own look. Everyone with the mod sees the map the way its author set it up.

items.title: Auto quality
items.text: Turns off the most expensive effects when your frame rate drops, and brings them back later.

items.title: VR (experimental)
items.text: Runs next to the VR mod TrackMania Forever OpenXR, with the menu in the headset.

blocks.title: Install
blocks.markdown:
**With the ModLoader (TMLoader), it updates itself.** Close the ModLoader, open `%LOCALAPPDATA%\TMLoader\config.yaml` and add this line under `servers:`:

```
  - 'https://cheatoskar.github.io/TM-Vibrant-Shaders/modloader/'
```

Start the ModLoader, tick *TM Vibrant Shaders* in your profile and start the game.

**With the setup.** Download `TM-Vibrant-Shaders.zip` from the latest release, extract it, close the game and run `TM-Vibrant-Shaders-Setup.exe`. It installs into the ModLoader, into Nations or United Forever (as `d3d9.dll`), or into TrackMania 2 (as `d3d11.dll`).

Press `F8` in the game for the menu. Settings and presets stay in `Documents\TrackMania\TMVS`.

rows.action: Open or close the menu (F5 when CenterSpeed is loaded)
Effects on or off (TMNF and TMUF)
Photo mode: split screen, game without and with the mod
Screenshot and frame capture (a photo in photo mode)

rows.note: Unofficial 1.80 patch only; the look and photos, no car or video features

items.q: How strong a PC do I need?
items.a: A GTX 1050 at 1080p with the Performance preset is the minimum. A GTX 1080 Ti at 1440p runs at 70 to 90 FPS. Auto quality is on by default and holds your frame rate.

items.q: How do I open the menu?
items.a: Press F8 in the game. F5 if CenterSpeed is loaded, because CenterSpeed uses F8.

items.q: Does it work with CenterSpeed and Competition Patch?
items.a: Yes, both. With CenterSpeed loaded the menu opens with F5.
Press F12 there and attach the screenshot and the capture to an issue on GitHub, with tmvs.log from Documents\TrackMania\TMVS.
The setup is not code-signed. Choose More info, then Run anyway, or install through the ModLoader or by hand.
